name: simurgh-code
description: SiMurgh Code (SMC) - a radial hexagonal 2D symbology with an m-sequence angle track, Golay(24,12) format crown and Reed-Solomon interleaved payload.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @simurgh/core && npm run build -w @simurgh/cli
scripts.bench: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js bench
